item.text: [{"task_id":"14754a24","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    marker = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    substrate = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    paint = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    required = int(round(params['minimum'][0]))","    offsets = [(int(round(pair[0])), int(round(pair[1]))) for pair in params['cross']]","    out = grid.copy()","    height, width = grid.shape","    for row in range(height):","        for col in range(width):","            cells = []","            valid = True","            markers = 0","            for dr, dc in offsets:","                rr, cc = row + dr, col + dc","                if rr < 0 or rr >= height or cc < 0 or cc >= width:","                    valid = False","                    break","                value = grid[rr, cc]","                if value != marker and value != substrate:","                    valid = False","                    break","                markers += int(value == marker)","                cells.append((rr, cc))","            if valid and markers >= required:","                for rr, cc in cells:","                    if grid[rr, cc] == substrate:","                        out[rr, cc] = paint","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[3],"minimum":[1],"cross":[5,2]},"params":{"colors":[4,5,2],"minimum":[2],"cross":[[0,0],[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]]},"rationale":"Find five-cell orthogonal crosses composed entirely of yellow and gray, containing at least two yellow cells.
